title: koine proposal
description: The proposal envelope — the day-one gesture (Law 2: an incoming version is a proposal; the field-wise conflict list IS the merge). A proposal is a standalone whole item; per Law 4 it never travels inside the target repo.

path.description: The target's path at drafting time

baseContentHash.description: The target's contentHash the proposal was drafted against — staleness is mechanically detectable

baseChainHead.description: The history chain head at drafting time — a receiver can tell whether history moved since

schema.description: The declared record type the resulting shape is checked against (e.g. koine/types/metric-definition@v0)

proposer.description: Who proposes. Authorship is attributed, not proven — proving it is the signing chapter

when.description: ISO-8601 UTC (Z), as everywhere in koine

changes.description: The field-wise diff this proposal intends — receipt recomputes it and must agree

resultingShape.description: The complete shape after applying the changes; MUST validate against the declared record type

openQuestions.description: What the proposer could not decide — surfaced, never silently resolved
